acceptanceCriteria: A1: The English Simplified Chinese and Japanese parity tables contain a row for WI-128 with its three-language Work Item documentation and verification evidence.
A2: Documentation acceptance derives the highest implemented Work Item ID from canonical Work Item docs and requires that ID in every parity language.
A3: The gate fails closed with an actionable omission when the latest implemented Work Item is absent from any parity document.
A4: The distinction between the implemented status projection and deferred full adopter capability manifest remains explicit.
A5: The gate remains deterministic and does not mutate Runtime, Contract, Summary, or evidence state.
goal: Ensure every latest implemented Work Item is represented in all three parity documents and cannot silently disappear from documentation acceptance.
intent: Make reference parity completeness enforceable instead of relying on a manually maintained fixed Work Item list.
